description: Runs one operation from api_catalog as the person, with the same permission checks The Deployer's app applies: domains, scaling, start/stop and schedules, databases and other cloud services, app access, build inputs, code review, hosting plans, retries, environments, blueprints, servers, adoption and more. Reads work with any key; changes need a key with Operate access, and ones that cost money or change a live app need the person's yes first. Secrets are never returned.

body.description: The JSON body, for POST, PUT and PATCH

path.description: The operation's path with ids filled in, e.g. /projects/12/scaling

workspace.description: Act in a teammate's workspace: its id from account. Default: your own.
